lines.ro: 480 qabl-e-maseeh. Yunan ke saahil par ek tang pahaari raasta, jis ka naam tha Thermopylae.
Ek taraf oonchi chataanein theen, aur doosri taraf gehra samandar. Beech mein sirf itni jagah ke chand aadmi kandhe se kandha mila kar khade ho sakein.
Us subah, is raaste mein teen sau sipahi khade the. Surkh chaadarein, kaansi ke khood, aur haathon mein lambe neze.
Aur unke saamne, jahan tak nazar jaati thi, duniya ki sab se badi fauj phaili hui thi.
Yeh kahani hai Sparta ke badshah Leonidas ki, aur un teen sau aadmiyon ki, jinhon ne jaante boojhte maut ka raasta chuna.
Magar yeh samajhne ke liye ke woh wahan kyun khade the, humein das saal peechhe jaana hoga.
Us zamane mein duniya ki sab se taaqatwar saltanat Faras ki thi. Hindustan ki sarhad se le kar Misr tak, sab us ke qabze mein tha.
Us ka badshah Dara khud ko badshahon ka badshah kehta tha. Laakhon log us ke hukm par jeete aur marte the.
Dara ne Yunan ke shehron mein apne qaasid bheje. Paigham saada tha. Mitti aur paani bhejo, yaani hamari itaat qubool karo.
Bohat se shehron ne dar kar sar jhuka diya. Magar jab qaasid Sparta pahunche, to Sparta walon ne unhein ek gehre kunwein mein phenk diya.
Aur kaha, mitti aur paani chahiye? Neeche ja kar khud le lo.
Dara ne Yunan par hamla kiya, magar Marathon ke maidan mein Athens ki chhoti si fauj ne use shikast de di.
Dara yeh zillat le kar mar gaya. Aur us ka beta Khashayar takht par baitha, jise Yunani Xerxes kehte the.
Xerxes ne qasam khaai ke woh baap ka badla lega. Aur is baar woh aisi fauj le kar aayega jo duniya ne kabhi na dekhi ho.
Chaar saal tak poori saltanat mein tayyari hoti rahi. Har soobe se sipahi, ghode, jahaz aur anaaj jama kiya gaya.
Is fauj mein chaalees se zyada qaumein theen. Misri, Babli, Hindustani teerandaaz, Arab oont sawaar, aur Habsha ke sipahi jo jismon par rang mal kar ladte the.
Har qaum apne libaas aur apne hathiyaaron ke saath thi. Aisa lagta tha jaise poori duniya Yunan par chadh aayi ho.
Asia aur Europe ke beech samandar ki ek patti thi, Hellespont. Xerxes ne saikdon kashtiyan jod kar us par pul banwa diya.
Kehte hain jab ek toofan ne pehla pul tod diya, to Xerxes ne ghusse mein samandar ko kode lagane ka hukm diya.
Phir naya pul bana, aur saat din aur saat raatein fauj us par se guzarti rahi.
Abydos ke maqaam par Xerxes ek sang-e-marmar ke takht par baith kar apni fauj aur apne jahaz dekh raha tha. Pehle woh khush hua, phir rone laga.
Us ke chacha ne wajah poochhi to bola, soch raha hoon ke in laakhon mein se sau saal baad ek bhi zinda nahin hoga.
Qadeem moarrikh Herodotus likhta hai ke yeh fauj itni badi thi ke raaste ke darya pi kar khushk kar deti thi.
Aaj ke moarrikh kehte hain ke is mein shayad dedh se teen laakh sipahi the. Phir bhi, us waqt ki duniya ke liye yeh naqabil-e-tasawwur tha.
Is fauj ke beech das hazaar chune hue sipahi the, jinhein Amar kaha jaata tha. Kyunke jab ek girta, fauran doosra us ki jagah le leta.
Yunan koi ek mulk nahin tha. Yeh chhote chhote azaad shehron ka majmooa tha, jo aksar aapas mein hi ladte rehte the.
In mein ek shehar sab se alag tha. Sparta. Us ke gird koi deewar nahin thi. Sparta wale kehte the, hamare sipahi hi hamari deewar hain.
Sparta wale baat bhi kam karte the. Un ke kam lafzon mein badi baat kehne ke andaaz se ek lafz bana, laconic. Jo aaj bhi angrezi mein bola jaata hai.
Sparta ka har azaad mard sirf ek hi pesha rakhta tha. Sipahi. Kheti baadi aur baaqi sab kaam ghulaam karte the, jinhein Helot kaha jaata tha.
Sparta mein jab koi ladka saat saal ka hota, to use maa se le kar fauji tarbiyat gaah mein bhej diya jaata.
Wahan nange paaon chalna sikhaya jaata, saal bhar ek hi chaadar milti, aur khana itna kam ke ladke bhook bardasht karna seekh jaayein.
Daud, kushti, neza, dhaal. Aur sab se badh kar ek sabaq. Maidan se kabhi peeth pher kar mat bhaagna.
Ladkon ko chori karna bhi sikhaya jaata tha, taake woh chaalaak banein. Magar jo pakda jaata, use sakht saza milti. Chori par nahin, pakde jaane par.
Bees saal ki umar mein woh sipahi banta, aur saath saal ki umar tak fauj ka hissa rehta. Saari zindagi ek hi maqsad ke liye.
Jab beta jang par jaata, to Sparta ki maa use dhaal de kar kehti, ya ise le kar lautna, ya is par let kar.
Yaani ya to jeet kar aana, ya mar kar. Dhaal phenk kar bhaagne wale ke liye Sparta mein koi jagah nahin thi.
Leonidas bhi isi tarbiyat se guzra tha. Woh badshah ka teesra beta tha, aur kisi ko umeed nahin thi ke woh kabhi takht par baithega.
Magar us ke donon bade bhai ek ek kar ke duniya se chale gaye, aur taqreeban pachaas saal ki umar mein Leonidas Sparta ka badshah ban gaya.
Sparta ke badshah khud ko Yunan ke sab se bade soorma Heracles ki aulaad maante the. Aur Leonidas ke naam ka matlab tha, sher ka beta.
Sparta mein ek waqt mein do badshah hote the. Ek shehar mein rehta, aur doosra jang mein fauj ki qiyaadat karta.
Us ki biwi Gorgo bhi kam mashhoor nahin thi. Woh apni zehanat ke liye jaani jaati thi.
Kisi ne us se poochha, Sparta ki auratein hi mardon par hukm kyun chalaati hain? Gorgo ne kaha, kyunke hum hi mard paida karti hain.
Kehte hain Faras ke hamle se pehle Sparta mein ek ajeeb takhti pahunchi. Lakdi ki takhti, jis par mom ki teh thi, magar kuchh likha hua nahin tha.
Koi nahin samajh saka ke yeh kya hai. Tab Gorgo ne kaha, mom khurcho. Aur mom ke neeche, lakdi par khuda hua paigham mila.
Xerxes Yunan par hamle ki tayyari kar raha hai. Yeh khufiya paigham Faras mein rehne wale ek Yunani ne bheja tha. Aur use sirf ek aurat ne padh liya tha.
480 qabl-e-maseeh ki garmiyon mein khabar aayi. Xerxes ki fauj Europe mein daakhil ho chuki thi, aur shimaali Yunan ke shehar ek ek kar ke jhuk rahe the.
Sparta walon ne Delphi ke mandir se mashwara maanga, jahan ki pujaaran ki peshgoiyon par poora Yunan yaqeen karta tha.
Jawaab dara dene wala tha. Ya to Sparta ka shehar tabaah hoga, ya Sparta apne ek badshah ka maatam karega.
Leonidas ne yeh peshgoi suni, aur khamosh raha. Shayad woh usi din samajh gaya tha ke woh badshah kaun hoga.
Magar ek masla tha. Yeh Carneia ke mazhabi tehwaar ke din the, aur is dauraan Sparta ki fauj jang ke liye nahin nikal sakti thi.
Shehar ke buzurgon ne kaha, tehwaar khatam hone do, phir poori fauj jaayegi. Magar tab tak Faras ki fauj Yunan ke beech pahunch chuki hoti.
Tab Leonidas ne faisla kiya. Woh apne zaati muhaafizon ko le kar abhi jaayega. Sirf teen sau aadmi.
Aur us ne un teen sau ko chunte waqt ek shart rakhi. Sirf wohi aadmi jaayenge jin ke ghar mein beta maujood ho.
Taake jab woh wapas na aayein, to un ka khandaan khatam na ho. Leonidas jaanta tha ke yeh waapsi ka safar nahin hai.
Jaane se pehle Gorgo ne poochha, mere liye kya hukm hai? Leonidas ne kaha, kisi achhe aadmi se shaadi karna, aur achhe bachche paida karna.
Agli subah teen sau Spartan shehar se nikle. Auratein, bachche aur boodhe khamoshi se unhein jaata dekhte rahe.
Raaste mein doosre Yunani shehron ke sipahi bhi saath milte gaye. Thespiae se saat sau, Thebes se chaar sau, aur kai doosre shehron se daste.
Kul mila kar taqreeban saat hazaar Yunani. Un ke saamne laakhon ki fauj thi.
Khule maidan mein yeh muqabla ek ghanta bhi na chalta. Is liye Leonidas ne maidan nahin, ek tang raasta chuna.
Thermopylae ka matlab hai garam darwaaze. Yahan pahaaron se garam paani ke chashme behte the.
Shimaal se junoobi Yunan aane ka yahi ek bada raasta tha. Aur is ke sab se tang hisse mein sadak sirf pandrah bees meter chaudi thi.
Wahan ek purani tooti hui patthar ki deewar thi. Yunaniyon ne din raat lag kar use dobaara khada kiya.
Leonidas ka mansooba saada tha. Is tang jagah mein dushman ki ginti be-maani ho jaayegi. Ek waqt mein sirf chand aadmi hi lad sakenge.
Aur aamne saamne ki ladaai mein Spartan duniya ke behtareen sipahi the.
Aaj agar aap Thermopylae jaayein, to wahan koi tang raasta nazar nahin aayega. Dhaai hazaar saal mein daryaon ki mitti ne samandar ko kai kilometer peechhe dhakel diya hai.
Magar us zamane mein, yahan chataanon aur lehron ke beech ek aisa darwaaza tha, jise band kar diya jaaye to poora Yunan mehfooz ho jaata.
Magar maqami logon ne ek khatre ki khabar di. Pahaaron ke oopar se ek pagdandi guzarti thi, jo is raaste ke peechhe ja nikalti thi.
Leonidas ne Phocis shehar ke ek hazaar sipahi us pagdandi ki hifaazat par laga diye.
Usi waqt, qareeb hi samandar mein, Athens ki qiyaadat mein Yunani jahaz Artemisium ke paas Faras ke bede ka raasta roke khade the.
Agar khushki ka raasta khulta, ya samandar ka, to Yunan khatam tha. Donon darwaazon ko ek saath band rakhna tha.
Aur qudrat ne bhi Yunan ka saath diya. Ek zabardast toofan aaya, aur Faras ke saikdon jahaz chataanon se takra kar doob gaye.
Phir ek din, ufaq par gard ka toofan utha. Faras ki fauj aa pahunchi thi.
